column1: # keys.tsv: every key of Mack's tmux + WezTerm setup, the ONE list the key
# help (prefix ?, `agent-ui keys`) draws. Add a row here whenever you add a
# key. tests/test_keys_catalog.py checks every row that names a tmux table
# against a private server that loaded the real config (@spaces on), and
# every key that config binds against these rows (or its NOT_IN_HELP list).
# TAB-separated, one key per row, sections in display order (first row of a
# section places it). Lines starting with # and blank lines are skipped.
#   1 section      the group it is listed under
#   2 key          as Mack reads it: ⌘ ⌥ ⌃ ⇧ glyphs, the prefix written ⌃S;
#                  space-separated parts are drawn as separate key caps
#                  (a bare "/" or "then" between them stays plain text)
#   3 description  what it does, short (about 40 cells, at most 50)
#   4 table        the tmux key table that binds it (root, prefix, jump,
#                  stash), or empty: WezTerm, Karabiner, a plugin, a popup's
#   5 tmux keys    the tmux key names in that table, space-separated;
#                  must be bound by OUR config: the test fails a key whose
#                  binding is still tmux's stock one, unless it is written
#                  `=key` (a stock binding we list on purpose: `=z`)
#   6 note        a dim detail after the description (optional)
# Keys only the classic (spaces off) layout binds are not listed.
